name: One day of spring break with her
source:
"One day of Spring break with her" tells a story about two young adult women, childhood friends reunited for only a day before they'll have to go their separate ways once more. Will they confess the feelings they've been holding for so many feelings, or forever hold them in silence...?

[Edited from [url=https://lazybearzlol.itch.io/one-day-of-spring-break-with-her]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《和她一起过春假的一天》讲述了两个青梅竹马的年轻女性只重聚一天，就不得不再次分道扬镳的故事。他们会坦白自己一直以来的感情，还是永远保持沉默……？

[编辑自[url=https://lazybearzlol.itch.io/one-day-of-spring-break-with-her]itch.io[/url]]
